description: Translate identifiers across databases via UniProt's ID-mapping service — gene names to accessions, accession to PDB / Ensembl / RefSeq / ChEMBL / GeneID, and back. The job runs asynchronously; this tool submits it and polls within a budget. A running job returns status "running" with a ticket; pass that ticket alone to poll the same job. A completed call returns status "finished" with one results page; when continuation is present, pass it alone to fetch the next completed page without re-submitting or polling the job. A gene name often maps to one reviewed Swiss-Prot accession plus dozens of unreviewed TrEMBL ones, so target UniProtKB-Swiss-Prot (reviewed only) for the usual intent, or UniProtKB to include TrEMBL. Pair a gene-symbol from_db with tax_id to disambiguate species. A row whose UniProtKB target is inactive (merged, demerged, or deleted) carries an inactive marker naming its replacements. Chain the resulting active accessions into uniprot_get_entry.

continuation.description: Completed-page continuation from a prior status "finished" response. Pass it alone to fetch the next page without polling or re-submitting.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next completed results page.

jobId.description: UniProt ID-mapping job identifier for the completed job.

from_db.description: Source database. Gene_Name = HGNC symbol (pair with tax_id); UniProtKB_AC-ID = accession or entry name; Ensembl/Ensembl_Protein = ENSG/ENSP; PDB; RefSeq_Nucleotide/RefSeq_Protein = NM_/NP_; ChEMBL; GeneID = NCBI Gene. Required only when submitting a new mapping job; omitted when resuming with a ticket or continuation.

ids.description: Identifiers to translate. Required only when submitting a new mapping job; omitted when resuming with a ticket or continuation.

items.description: A source identifier in the from_db namespace, e.g. "TP53" for Gene_Name.

tax_id.description: NCBI taxon ID to disambiguate ambiguous source IDs (e.g. a gene symbol across species). Recommended with Gene_Name; e.g. 9606 for human.

ticket.description: Running-job ticket from a prior status "running" response. Pass it alone to poll that job; do not combine it with continuation or submission inputs.

to_db.description: Target database. UniProtKB-Swiss-Prot = reviewed accessions only (the usual intent); UniProtKB also includes unreviewed TrEMBL. Required only when submitting a new mapping job; omitted when resuming with a ticket or continuation.

name: uniprot_map_ids

continuation.description: Next completed-page continuation (finished jobs only). Pass it alone to fetch the next page; absent on the terminal page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next completed results page.

jobId.description: UniProt ID-mapping job identifier for the completed job.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_inputs`: No complete submission, running-job ticket, or completed-page continuation was provided. `conflicting_inputs`: Submission inputs, a running-job ticket, or a completed-page continuation were combined. `unsupported_db_pair`: The from_db/to_db combination is not supported by the ID-mapping service. `invalid_ticket`: The resume ticket is not a UniProt job ID, or is unknown or has expired server-side (UniProt holds jobs only temporarily). `invalid_continuation`: The completed-page continuation has an invalid job ID, is unknown or expired, or UniProt rejected the page with HTTP 400. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

mappedCount.description: Number of resolved mappings (finished jobs only).

notice.description: Status guidance — e.g. that the job is still running, that no IDs mapped, or that inactive targets could not be marked on this page.

results.description: Resolved mappings on this completed page (present only when status is "finished"). Failed source IDs are reported in unmappedIds.

from.description: The source identifier that was mapped.

inactive.description: Present only when the target accession is inactive in UniProtKB — it has no entry to fetch; use replacedBy or uniParcId instead. Absent for an active target.

deletedReason.description: Why UniProt deleted the target, when it says. Present on DELETED only.

reason.description: UniProt inactiveReasonType: MERGED, DEMERGED, or DELETED. Omitted when UniProt names none.

replacedBy.description: Accessions that replace the target — the merge target (MERGED) or the demerge products (DEMERGED).

uniParcId.description: UniParc ID that still holds the sequence, when UniProt gives one.

to.description: The resolved target identifier (e.g. a UniProtKB accession).

status.description: Job state: "finished" (one completed results page included) or "running" (poll with ticket).

ticket.description: Running-job ticket (present only when status is "running"). Pass it alone to poll the same job.

unmappedIds.description: Source IDs UniProt reported as failed on this completed page. Absent when none failed.

items.description: A source ID that resolved to nothing.

title: uniprot-mcp-server: map IDs
